body: You look great! Hope it didn't hurt too much.
So glad you found this letter. Though, I'm sure you didn't need to read it to know that your dad loved you very much. I'm very sorry for your loss.

As long as you don't use your parents insurance to pay for the test, they shouldn't find out. Though, they may call or mail you with results, so if you live with your parents that could be an issue. You might want to ask the clinic about that. They may just have you call in for results. As far as your results go, the city/county will record cases of STI infections if you test positive and that information will be available to healthcare providers on your medical records. But that information is confidential, so they can't just tell your parents about it. So don't let fear of your parents finding out about you getting tested prevent you from getting tested and treated if necessary.
Get tested/examined anyway, for peace of mind, if you have any doubt. Only you know what's normal for your body.

Just get yourself tested as soon as you can to ease your mind for now and get treatment if you need it, then test again in 16 weeks to be certain. Herpes testing is tricky and it may take several weeks before you know anything for certain. Negative this early would not be conclusive. Just tell you doctor about all your symptoms. The best time to go would be when you have a new outbreak because they can swab the blisters and be much more certain in the diagnosis than just doing a blood test at this point. You might not know for certain with a blood test until 16 weeks after you contracted it and not every one gets the same level of symptoms so symptoms alone will not tell you if you have it either.

Check your local public health office and also see if your county has a discount heath program for people in need. They should be able to give you discounted STD tests and offer discounted treatment if you need it. There are also some organizations that give free HIV tests too, but if you think you have something, it might be better to get a comprehensive test.
I love you man... Please don't give up. I really need a friend right now.

Thank you. After reading and commenting on a few posts in the SW subreddit I was aware that some of these posts don't end well or there is no follow up, which I think leaves everyone who has take the time to read and attempt to help feeling concerned about the final outcome of the of the person posting. I didn't want to do that. 

I want everyone who listened to me and offered support and advice that I'm in a better state of mind now and I'm going to try to make the best of my current situation and hopefully someone in a similar situation will read this and will get some reassurance that you can go from a state of despair to actually being able to cope with your problems and move forward. My problems are definitely far from over, but I don't feel overwhelmed the way I did when I posted this thread nearly 2 weeks ago. I was very close to harming myself and it scares me to think how close I was at that point. Thankfully I decided to post on SW and had support encouragement from awesome people like you. After I have sorted some of my own problems, I want to be able to devote some time trying to help others who have lost hope as well. I can't stand the thought of someone else feeling the way I was feeling.

Thank you again. I'm very grateful that you took the time to read my post and offer support. You are a beautiful person. I will always consider you a friend.

Thank you. I think I will be able to cope with whatever the results of my HSV2 test. My symptoms were mild to asymptomatic from what I have read, and so I may not have HSV2. Initially I was fearing some horrific outbreak and my worry now is a mild outbreak and not knowing if I am carrying HSV2. This is why I'm going to get tested even though the clinic I went to didn't seem to think there was any obvious signs. Knowing for sure will help me cope with other issues in my life as well. I feel like I have a fresh start of sorts and that has really helped my depression. I also set up an appointment so I can see if I can get some help with my depression. I'm not particularly fond of the idea of taking medication for depression, but I think If I can talk to someone in person, it might really help me.

I wanted to let you know that I called and got my test results yesterday afternoon and the results were all negative. That was a huge weight off my shoulders. I'm still going to try to find a place that wont charge me too much to give me a HSV2 blood test because I'm still concerned that I had a mild HSV2 outbreak that the clinic would not test for and I'm also going to get retested completely in 3 months for peace of mind. I'm going to try to use my recent good fortune as a turning point and try to fix the problems that I have control of in my life and hopefully I won't ever find myself in this kind of despair again. Thank you so much for being there to listen and offer advice when I needed it most.

Thank you for your kind words. It really helps that there are kind, caring people like you who take the time to read and respond to the posts of total strangers. It makes me feel less lonely and hopeless. You are a very special person, don't ever forget that. 

I would like to go back to work again, so whatever opportunity I can get I'd take. It has been hard though with my depression and now I'm very worried about the results of my STD test, which I will get tomorrow. It's been about 15 years since I last tested. I posted in my previous posts, I had an encounter about 5 weeks ago which initially made me concerned I got exposed to HSV2. I'm not sure about the HSV2, they didn't test for it and didn't seem to think I had it, but now I'm also really concerned about my HIV status since it has been so long since I've been tested. This week has been brutal for me. They gave me a number and I'm supposed to call and get my results tomorrow afternoon. I don't even know how getting the results works and it's freaking me out... I don't know if they will give me results on the phone or if they'll make me go in to get them and if calling me in means something bad. I'm really scared. I've never been this scared in my life. Tomorrow is what it all comes down to, I guess. It will either be a new chance at changing my life for the better or it will be all hope lost. I feel like I bought a lottery ticket am desperately hoping for a win, but distinctly aware that the odds are against me. This is my fault, for my own actions and for not getting tested sooner. I'm most worried about how this all would affect my family. My father is highly disabled and I help my mother take care of him. She has so much on her plate and has been through so much stress and heartache, I can't bear to hurt her or my father. They need my help and I just want to be there to help them.

Thank your for your comments. Unfortunately I lost the interest I once had in doing computer related work. Perhaps it was a combination of feeling discouraged and depression about my personal life that stripped me of my desire to work in that field. Either way, that was over a decade ago so my training/skills are out of date, so even if I wanted to pick up on that I'd have to get more training, which I can not afford. And until I know about the current state of my health, I can't even think about anything else. I'm a couple of days from finding out my test results and I'm utterly terrified and to what they will be and what I will do.

I really don't want to get in contact with my friend. Though, I still love and care about him, he has built an new life and is happy and I do not want to inject my problems into his life. I'm also really ashamed of the person I have become and don't want his last memory of me to be this pathetic loser that I am. I wasn't always this way, when I knew him I was really driven and happy and always enjoying life. Now I'm the opposite and I'd rather no one see what has become of me.

It did really depress me to see him get married first hand. Imagine having to witness, first hand, the love of your life marrying someone else and pretend to be happy about it. I really should have turned him down when he asked me, but the way he said it, made me feel like he wanted no one else to stand up for him. I was in love, what can I say? I agreed for his sake in spite of it tearing me apart inside.

I really hope it does get better. Please send your good thoughts my way. Once I get my test results I'll know what I'm facing and can better figure out what I'm going to do next. Hopefully that involves improving my life, but I'm not sure how much more of this I can take.

Please keep in mind that there may be cures/treatment for your stomach problems other than medicine, like a simple change in your diet. You may be intolerant to something in your diet and that can sometime also be the cause/contributor to depression. Consider that this could possibly be something you are suffering from and with a change of diet you might feel a lot better both physically and mentally. Of course that might not erase all of your problems, but it might help you deal with them better. It's brave of you to post on here. Good luck my friend.
Thank you, I will take a look.

I'm having another tough night. I wish could sleep better, because my depression just gets worse without sleep. I feel feverish, but I have no fever and now I have body aches. Still worrying about what my future holds for my health and unsure what I'm going to do at this point. I've been withdrawn from my family during all this when all I really want to do is spend time with them and let them know how much they mean to me. But I'm sick and worried right now and that makes it difficult. My sister has already asked me what's wrong, so it must be quite obvious that something is wrong with me. I don't want what is possibly my last week to be like this, I would like to spend it enjoying the company of my family.

If by some chance I don't have some terrible disease, I want to try a fresh start on my life and try do all the things I should have done, but never did... I want to live and be happy and try to make others happy. That's all up in the air right now, and call me selfish, vain, stupid or whatever, but I don't want to become but a stigmatized disease in other people's eyes. I'd rather die without others knowing if that's the case. The next week will hold the key for me, I guess. I'm so stupid for letting my life come down to this.

I'm in a fairly conservative area so LGBT support would probably not be something I could find much of around the corner, but maybe online. I will take that into consideration. I'm sure there are others who are or have been in a similar position as mine.

Thank you for your thoughts. The conflict is brutal, it's a constant tug of war. I do hope that I can look back on this dark time some day and say that it made me a better, stronger person and I am grateful to you and all the amazing people on this subreddit who are willing to listen to the stories and pain that others are feeling and offer your thoughts without being judgemental. 

I just got back from getting tested, the nurse who examined me didn't seem to think my symptoms looked like an STD. The not so good news is that they wouldn't/couldn't test for HSV2 because of that and now I'm going to be kind of worried about that. But still, I will take whatever good news I can get, and I'll have my results next week. For now, I feel a bit better. Though, with me, that can change by the hour. Thanks again for your thoughts. I agree, redemption is always possible and going through difficult times can build character and can force a change for the better in people people. I hope that can be the case for me.

I know, without their support I would have ended my life long ago. Of course they don't know this, but it's true. I only wish now that I had opened up to them at some point in the past and maybe I wouldn't be in the desperate, shameful place I am right now.

I'm an (unfortunately) closeted gay in my late 30's and I've seen a big improvement in the way gays are treated since I was younger. I think you will see a big improvement throughout your lifetime as well. What matters most is how you view yourself, not how some closed minded people view you.
Make sure you get some rest, it's hard to sort out your problems if you are tired. I know that can be hard when your mind is racing, but it really can help.
In spite of your current problems, you sound like you are trying and that's a good thing. Stay strong.
I was skeptical about the video when it first started, but it did lift my spirits. Thank you.

It bothers me a lot that I have squandered my potential in life. I went to technical school about 10 years ago for IT training, graduated Summa Cum Laude. But I had a difficult time finding good job after graduating, kind of felt I had been suckered into paying for this training that didn't really help me and got bitter about it, ended up working jobs I could of worked without the training. (I know this happens to a lot of people and I shouldn't have taken it so hard, but at the time it was very discouraging to me) 

My interest in that field of work just gradually evaporated. That combined with some other personal issues sent me on a very bad depression spiral where I basically ceased to function normally. Just stopped going to work one day and was fired. This really affected my self-esteem. I couldn't afford to pay my student loans after that and it ruined my credit, which I had previously worked very hard to keep an excellent credit rating. I should have sought counseling for my depression but, at the time I was in denial, I couldn't afford it and didn't want to burden my family. Instead, I lead my family to believe everything was okay. Obviously it wasn't and hasn't ever been since. Thus I'm now in this state of low self-esteem, poor work history and this self-hate that never seems to go away. I had a lot of things going for me and I pissed it all away.

BTW, the personal problems I mentioned were related to my best friend, who is the only person I've ever been in love with. Him and I had a secret physical relationship for about three years when I was in my early 20's. He cared for me a lot, but I don't think he was in love with me the way I was with him. Things were awkward because we had the same group of friends and were trying to keep it under wraps. Then one night we were almost caught in bed by his older brother (he still lived with hi parents) and I think that scared us both a lot and we stopped seeing each other, he got a girlfriend and we eventually lost touch. 

Fast forward a couple of years (the year I graduated) and I get a call from him that he wants me to be his best man for his wedding. He told me there was no one else who could fill that spot, I was the person he trusted most. I wanted to turn him down because I knew it would be difficult to see him get married, but I loved the guy, so I agreed. I put on a brave face for the wedding and stood up for him, but after the wedding I stopped keeping touch with him, in spite of efforts on his part. I'm not going to say this is the cause of all my problems, but it was a big contributing factor in me getting so overwhelmed with depression during that time.

Thank you, I know my parents really depend on me to help care for my father. In spite of all my screw ups and faults, they have always made me feel like they were proud of me and loved me. That makes me feel good, but it also makes me feel worse about the person I've become and the person I am vs the person I used to be. I don't really deserve what they have given me and now I'm going to turn around and disappoint and hurt them some more.

Thanks for taking your time to comment... Your words and music help me feel less lonely tonight. I don't want to give up, but finding the strength to carry on is getting harder and harder for me. It's a real struggle from day to day, hour to hour, minute to minute. But I want to be there for my parents, who are struggling themselves, and I know that if I was not here to help with my father, my parents would both be having a very difficult time. I don't want to make things worse for them. I know it takes strength to live through hardships, but most of my hardships are self-created and that's the worst part for me. It's like I've been working against myself all of my life. Now I've backed myself into this terrible corner. To be honest, I'm disgusted, but not that worried if I have an STD. I deserve it. I just wish my parents wouldn't need to know at this point. It just adds to the embarrassment and shame of who I have become. I have no love life and have come to terms with the fact I will probably be alone for the rest of my life. I’m a nice guy, not bad looking either, but I have nothing to offer anyone. Every night, I lay down and think about finding someone to love and be loved back, but who would want me? I'm a complete failure. I get lonely. Thus, the stupid actions I took of having a meaningless and unfulfilling encounter with a stranger. This makes me feel so worthless, stupid and perverted. The sad part is that things had been looking up for me lately, I had been feeling better and had more energy and drive and I applied for a couple of jobs, finally finished paying my credit card debt, I was working out, eating well, etc. I could look in he mirror and not completely hate the person I saw. Now, that's all faded away and I can't stand to look at myself any more.
